cands.name: Gladys A. Robinson
cands.bio: Democratic state senator for District 28 (Guilford County) since January 2011. Former executive director of Piedmont Health Services and Sickle Cell Agency, grant writer, and UNC Board of Governors member. Served as Senate Deputy Minority Leader. Holds a Ph.D. in leadership studies from N.C. A&T.

endorsements.text: Listed by Ballotpedia as recommended by several Sway voting groups in 2026: Black Mothers Who Vote Matter, GuilfordBlueNC, Reject AIPAC from City Council to Congress, and Waves of Democracy.

cands.gaps: We could not find where Robinson was born or raised, or when she came to North Carolina, so her ties to the state are not scored. We found no documented statements from her on data centers, development or growth, homestead property taxes, foreign or investor land buying, immigration or H-1B, policing, gun laws, school choice or teacher pay. The only stated position we found is her campaign site's mention of reproductive healthcare access. Her sponsored-bill list did not load, so we could not cite specific bills she introduced. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate surveys. We found no controversies or foreign ties in the pages we read.
